source_refs.note: Steady Flow: a main subheading of 5.8 Steady, non-viscous and ideal fluid, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 104-106.

blocks.text: If the overall flow pattern does not change with time, the flow is called steady flow.
bold: If the overall flow pattern does not change with time, the flow is called steady flow.

blocks.text: In steady flow, every particle of the fluid follows the same flow line as its previous particle.
